title: Psikyo Arcade Shooters Get Psikyo Memories Collection Release
content: Edia announced on Wednesday that it is developing Psikyo Memories , a collection of '90s arcade scrolling shooter games by Psikyo. Edia also revealed the collection will include Strikers 1945 .
author: ANN

title: Firefly Wedding Main Trailer Featuring Opening Theme Song by iri Revealed
content: Firefly Wedding TV anime revealed the main trailer with the opening theme “Period,” a new song written by iri for the series. The anime previously confirmed an October 9 premiere and a key visual .
author: Anime Corner

title: Horror Collector Anime's Video Reveals Cast, Staff, October 10 Debut, 12 Episode Run
content: The official website for the television anime of Midori Satō 's Horror Collector ( Kyōfu Collector ) novel series unveiled a new teaser trailer and visual for the anime on Friday. The video reveals the anime's cast, staff, and October 10 debut date for its 12-episode run.
author: ANN

title: 'Silent Witch' Author and 'Mushoku Tensei' Artist Begin New Light Novel
content: Silent Witch: Chinmoku no Majo no Kakushigoto ( Secrets of the Silent Witch ) author Matsuri Isora and Mushoku Tensei: Isekai Ittara Honki Dasu ( Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation ) illustrator Sirotaka will begin a new light novel titled Boukyaku no Curse Knight ( The Curse Knight of Oblivion ), the official X…
author: MyAnimeList

title: 'Kyoufu Collector' Reveals Main Cast, Staff, Teaser Promo
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Midori Satou 's Kyoufu Collector ( Horror Collector ) novel revealed the main cast, staff, a key visual (pictured), and teaser promotional video on Friday. The anime series is scheduled to premiere on October 10 at 11:45 p.m. on NHK-G.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Butt Detective TV Anime Gets New Episodes Starting on October 3
content: The staff for the Butt Detective ( Oshiri Tantei ) anime announced on Friday that the anime will have seven new weekly episodes starting on October 3. The previous batch of new episodes debuted on April 4.
author: ANN

title: Suikoden Anime's New Video Reveals Ending Song, October 3 TV Debut
content: The staff for Suikoden: The Anime , the adaptation of Konami 's Suikoden II game's story, streamed the third full promotional video for the anime on Friday. The video previews the anime's opening theme song "Kanashimi Sae Otonabite" (Even in Sadness I'll Look Like an Adult) by amazarashi , announces and previews the…
author: ANN

title: Dark Machine the Animation Series Reveals 3rd Promo Video, Ending Theme Song, Manga Adaptation
content: The staff for Dark Machine the Animation , the original anime for the Dark Machine game and anime project , began streaming on Friday the third promotional video, and it reveals and previews the ending theme song "Galaxy Mode" by Sandaime J SOUL BROTHERS . The song will launch with the band's new album on October 21.
author: ANN

title: Edia Re-Releases Falcom's Dragon Slayer: The Legend of Heroes I & II Games
content: Edia announced on Wednesday that it will re-release Nihon Falcom's Dragon Slayer: The Legend of Heroes and Dragon Slayer: The Legend of Heroes II role-playing games. Edia did not announce a release date or platforms for the games.
author: ANN

title: The Diary of a Middle-Aged Sage's Carefree Life in Another World Anime's Teaser Unveils Tomokazu Sugita in Cast, January Debut
content: Kadokawa presented a new teaser promotional video for the television anime of Yasukiyo Kotobuki 's The Diary of a Middle-Aged Sage's Carefree Life in Another World ( Arafō Kenja no Isekai Seikatsu Nikki ) light novel series on Friday.
author: ANN
